seo.description: A 12-page digital marketing course brochure designed for Digital Mentor Academy.

sections.heading: Project overview
sections.body: The brochure had to communicate a large amount of course information without feeling like a syllabus pasted onto a page. I organised audience segments, learning highlights, modules, tools, certifications, placement assistance, reviews and career outcomes into a consistent sequence that supports both quick scanning and deeper reading.
